serve.rs[EN9L]: F:HTTP 后端 + MCP stdio 服务：路由、job、指标与 agent 工具 | R:code:crates/cli/src/main.rs,code:crates/core/src/engine.rs,code:crates/core/src/workbook/mod.rs | A:HTTP 读写与 job；run_mcp_stdio 一行一条 JSON-RPC；工具含 schema/view/filter/search/quality/pipeline_status/pipeline_run、edit_set/delete/undo/redo、convert、job_submit/job_status/job_cancel/job_list（16）；pipeline_run 接受 force/dryRun/dag/jobs/clean；job_status 支持 0–30s wait；job_cancel kill 子进程；job_list 默认状态+outputChars，full=true 返回完整输出；未知工具先判身份；父目录组件在 canonicalize 前拒绝 | S:strict 参数未登记即 400；MCP stdout 只走协议，工具失败 isError；job 结果缓存；tools/list 必须能被 McpParser 解析
